entities.summary: Adv Anjali Pawar the director of the child rights non-governmental organization Sakhee and a consultant at Against Child Trafficking in Pune, Maharashra, which works in the field of child protection issues. During the course of her career, Pawar has advocated for child rights issues and worked to reunite adopted children with their biological families.
